as_told.title: Ashton Forbes plasma orb wormhole theory of MH370

plain: Videos tied to MH370, the Malaysian airliner that vanished in 2014 in a story CNN covered for three months, are said to show three orbs circling the plane, and a researcher named Ashton Forbes claims they are man-made, fusion-powered plasma orbs that opened a spinning wormhole over the Nicobar Islands and teleported the plane westward, toward Diego Garcia. Michels retells Forbes's claim, which Forbes made on Twitter around 2024, across several episodes; if true, it would mean someone already has working teleportation technology.
